# Step-by-step network construction

This report calls the same extracted backend as the GUI but constructs the full
adjacency and TOM matrices instead of using WGCNA's blockwise method. This is
substantially more memory intensive for large gene sets.

## Environment setup

```{r}
source("set_parameters.R")
source("src/3_env_setup.R")
```

## Construct the network

```{r}
network_report <- run_network_construction(
  session_dir = session_name,
  method = "stepwise",
  tom_type = "auto",
  correlation_type = corType,
  merge_cut_height = mergeCutHeight,
  deep_split = deepSplit,
  min_module_size = minModSize,
  random_seed = rs,
  kmeans_refinement = TRUE,
  save_adjacency = TRUE
)

network_report
```

## Module counts and TOM artifacts

```{r}
network_report$module_counts
network_report$tom
```

The standardized network is stored in `out/3_networks.rds`. The TOM manifest
records both the RDS matrix and the legacy `TOM` RData file.
